translations.web: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.’
translations.bsb: Because you have followed the path of your sister, I will put her cup into your hand.’
translations.kjv: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.
translations.asv: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thy hand.
